title: Check videos without a caption track
user_impact: Deaf or hard-of-hearing users cannot perceive spoken content.
technical_impact: A <video> outside hidden and aria-hidden content, and not muted without controls, has no <track kind="captions"> or kind="subtitles" child and no <track> without kind (HTML reads a missing kind as subtitles; an invalid one, also empty or with spaces, as metadata), so spoken content may have no text equivalent; reported as a review hint, because captions can be burned into the picture or offered by the player, and the video may carry no speech or informative sound.

checks.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded) (H95, G87, F8); HTML §4.8.11.11 track; ACT f51b46
checks.applicability:
Every <video> not under the hidden attribute or aria-hidden="true", except a
muted video without controls (no sound anybody can turn on).
checks.expectation:
A video without a caption or subtitle <track> child is one REVIEW at the
video. A track without kind counts (HTML missing value default: subtitles); an
invalid kind, "" or " captions" included, is metadata and does not count;
keywords match ASCII case-insensitively without trimming (a11y-rules 0.31.1): captions can be burned in or offered by the player, and
the video may carry no speech or informative sound, so never a violation.
Descriptions or chapter tracks alone do not count. A video with such a track
gets no finding here, whether its file loads or not; that question and
third-party embeds are video-caption's (#1182), so no video is reported by
both rules.
